$schema-note: Semantic key -> exact filename, for the custom painted evolution-condition icons in this folder. Keys are the app's stable identifiers; filenames may be re-exported without touching calling code. src/modules/pokedex/evoConditionIcons.ts mirrors these keys as a TypeScript union and verify-evo-icons.mjs asserts the two agree and that every file listed here exists.
$render-context: The evolution chart on the species detail page, and nowhere else. The two gender entries are additionally namespaced -- see the note on `gender` below.

trade.gen1to4Uses: 17 details -- 3 plain trades (Alakazam, Machamp, Golem, Gengar) and 14 trade-holding-an-item

random-split.data: NOT IN THE DATA -- see the warning below. Needs a hardcoded species-pair rule.

location-moss-rock.condition: Level up near the Moss Rock

location-ice-rock.condition: Level up near the Ice Rock

location-mount-coronet.condition: Level up in the Mt. Coronet magnetic field

gender-male.scope: EVOLUTION CHART ONLY -- painted register, matching the other icons here. Reachable in code only through evoGenderIcon.ts, which ESLint forbids importing outside the evolution chart. Not a general-purpose gender glyph.

$warnings.random-split: NO RESOLVER, AND NONE NEEDED. The Wurmple 50/50 is not expressible from the bundle -- both branches carry byte-identical details (level-up, min_level 7, every other field null) because the real split is a personality value PokeAPI does not model. But nothing in this app tracks individual caught Pokemon either (no per-instance state, no IVs, no personality value, no persistence of any kind), so there is nothing to resolve FOR. The icon marks the branch point as random for display, with both outcomes drawn. Detection is structural -- 2+ siblings whose details are indistinguishable -- which fires on exactly one fork in the whole bundle (Wurmple) and needs no species list. See isIndistinguishableFork in src/modules/pokedex/evoConditionIcons.ts.
$warnings.location-naming: moss-rock and ice-rock are named for the in-game objects; the bundle names the surrounding location instead (Eterna Forest, Route 217). One location maps to one icon in both cases, so the mapping is still unambiguous. mount-coronet is the one whose asset name matches the data's own location name.
$warnings.dimensions: RESOLVED. All 11 are now 128x128 with the longest content side at 79.7% of the canvas, produced by scripts/normalize-evo-icons.mjs (alpha bounding box -> crop -> high-quality resize -> centre). As delivered they were 4 sizes from 128 to 1024 with content filling 69-97%, so icon-beauty drew ~40% larger than icon-moss-rock at the same CSS size. verify-evo-icons.mjs now GATES both, rather than reporting them. Originals are in git history at commit 5adc10d.
$warnings.weight: RESOLVED. 176 KB for the set, down from 3219 KB as delivered. The precache went 6715 KiB with the originals to 3672 KiB, i.e. the icons now cost 177 KiB over the pre-icon baseline of 3495 KiB instead of 3220 KiB. A 400 KB ceiling is asserted so an unnormalised original dropped in later cannot inflate the install payload silently.
